answers.questionText: Does the app allow users to purchase digital goods?

Can these purchases include random items where the purchaser doesn't know what specific items or features they will receive (e.g., loot boxes), the purchase of items that will be used to create or unlock an unknown item or feature (e.g., a key to unlock a loot box, material used to craft a random item), items that can improve the rate of earning random items (e.g., random drop boosts), or any other chance-based purchases?
